+Feature: Application readiness
+  Operators can verify that the application and its database are ready.
+
+  Scenario Outline: Check readiness
+    When I request "GET" "<path>"
+    Then the HTTP response status is 200
+    And the readiness response confirms the database is reachable
+
+    Examples:
+      | path    |
+      | /health |
+      | /up     |
+
+  Scenario Outline: Former note endpoints are unavailable
+    When I request "<method>" "<path>"
+    Then the HTTP response status is 404
+
+    Examples:
+      | method | path             |
+      | GET    | /notes           |
+      | POST   | /notes           |
+      | PATCH  | /notes/1/archive |

--- /dev/null
+++ b/features/step_definitions/application_steps.rb
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+When("I request {string} {string}") do |method, path|
+  @http_response = Rack::MockRequest.new(Rails.application).request(
+    method, path, "action_dispatch.show_exceptions" => :all
+  )
+end
+
+Then("the HTTP response status is {int}") do |status|
+  expect(@http_response.status).to eq(status)
+end
+
+Then("the readiness response confirms the database is reachable") do
+  expect(JSON.parse(@http_response.body)).to eq("status" => "ok")
+end

--- /dev/null
+++ b/spec/requests/application_boundary_spec.rb
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe "Application boundary", type: :request do
+  it "responds deliberately at the root without rendering a feature", :aggregate_failures do
+    get "/"
+
+    expect(response).to have_http_status(:no_content)
+    expect(response.body).to be_empty
+  end
+
+  it "does not expose the former note list" do
+    get "/notes", env: { "action_dispatch.show_exceptions" => :all }
+
+    expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
+  end
+
+  it "does not accept former note creation requests" do
+    post "/notes", params: { note: { title: "Synthetic note" } },
+                   env: { "action_dispatch.show_exceptions" => :all }
+
+    expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
+  end
+
+  it "does not accept former note archive requests" do
+    patch "/notes/1/archive", env: { "action_dispatch.show_exceptions" => :all }
+
+    expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
+  end
+
+  it "removes note controller routes" do
+    controllers = Rails.application.routes.routes.map { |route| route.defaults[:controller] }
+
+    expect(controllers).not_to include("notes")
+  end
+
+  it "removes the note model, controller, services and exclusive audit model", :aggregate_failures do
+    %i[Note NotesController Notes AuditLog].each do |constant|
+      expect(Object.const_defined?(constant)).to be(false), "Expected #{constant} to be removed"
+    end
+  end
+end
